name: Moodfit
one_liner: Moodfit is a comprehensive mental health app combining mood tracking with CBT exercises, gratitude journaling, goal setting, and breathing exercises in one platform.
best_for: People wanting an all-in-one mental health app with multiple tools
Those who like CBT exercises alongside mood tracking
People who benefit from gratitude practices and goal setting
Those wanting a more comprehensive approach than simple mood trackers
People interested in understanding their mental health patterns
not_for: Those wanting only simple, quick mood tracking (try Daylio)

Those who prefer minimalist single-purpose apps
short_description: All-in-one mental health app with mood tracking, CBT tools, gratitude journal, breathing exercises, and goal setting.
long_description: Moodfit takes a comprehensive approach to mental health self-care. The app includes mood tracking, CBT-based thought exercises, gratitude journaling, goal setting, breathing exercises, and educational content. It's designed as a 'mental health toolkit' with multiple tools you can use based on what you need each day. The app tracks your progress across these areas and shows how they relate to your overall mood.
patient_summary: Moodfit is like having a mental health toolkit in your pocket. Track your mood, practice CBT techniques, journal about gratitude, and do breathing exercises. See how everything connects over time.

pricing.notes: Free version includes core features. Premium adds more exercises, insights, and features.

privacy.notes: Data stored securely. No third-party data sharing.

faqs.q: How is Moodfit different from Daylio?
faqs.a: Daylio focuses on simple, icon-based mood tracking. Moodfit is more comprehensive, including CBT exercises, gratitude journaling, goal setting, and breathing exercises alongside mood tracking. Choose Daylio for simplicity, Moodfit for a full toolkit.
Yes. Moodfit includes CBT-based exercises like thought records, cognitive restructuring, and behavioral activation. These are guided exercises based on therapy techniques.

faqs.q: Can I use Moodfit for anxiety and depression?
faqs.a: Yes. Moodfit is designed for both. The mood tracking, CBT exercises, and breathing techniques are helpful for both anxiety and depression. The app doesn't diagnose but supports self-management.

Moodfit uses techniques from evidence-based therapies like CBT. While the app itself hasn't been studied in clinical trials, the techniques it teaches (CBT, gratitude practices, breathing exercises) have research support.
